build_MemoryEncoder: build a MemoryEncoder module to fuse pixel features with downsampled masks for SAM2 memory encoding
create_MaskDownSampler: create a MaskDownSampler to progressively downsample masks by total_stride with increasing channel capacity
create_CXBlock: create a CXBlock ConvNeXt block with depthwise conv, LayerNorm, and MLP for feature processing
create_Fuser: create a Fuser module to apply cloned CXBlock layers for fusing visual features and mask embeddings
test_MemoryEncoder_forward: test the MemoryEncoder forward pass with pixel features and masks to produce vision features and position encoding
